clue.text: Shut great room designed by queen's birth parent

indicators.note: something designed is laid out afresh, so these three words' letters are rearranged

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the usual crossword abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: An architect is asked to lay out a closed-off grand room for royalty's natural mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges SHUT GREAT ROOM; ER for queen goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who carries a pregnancy for someone else is literally the one who gives birth, hence a birth parent.

clue.text: Tree with special powers found by newly-cast Ariel

parts.note: ESP, extrasensory perception, is a kind of special mental power

indicators.note: a play newly cast reshuffles its roles, so the letters of Ariel are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Ariel, freshly cast in The Tempest, discovers a tree with magical powers.
explanation.walkthrough: Ariel is the spirit in Shakespeare's The Tempest, which fits 'newly-cast', but here the name is only letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit tree trained flat against a wall or trellis is called by this gardening term, so it can stand for a tree.

clue.text: Old hit set in Vegas motel

indicators.note: the letters wanted are set within the phrase Vegas motel, spanning its two words

explanation.surface: A golden oldie of a hit song plays in a Las Vegas motel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old hit' looks like a classic song; it is the archaic past tense of 'smite', meaning struck.
explanation.definitionFit: Struck is the archaic past tense form, so an old-fashioned word for hit.

clue.text: Debilitated cook never dined

indicators.note: to cook the books is to fiddle them, so the letters of never are fiddled into a new order

parts.note: dined means ate

explanation.surface: An exhausted cook never got round to eating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' looks like a noun, the person who never dined, but it is the verb signalling a rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective the word means weakened or drained of vigour, matching debilitated.

clue.text: Rugby player extremely eager to be polite

parts.note: a prop is a front-row forward in rugby

indicators.note: the extreme, outermost letters of the word eager are the ones wanted

explanation.surface: A rugby forward keen to show good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Proper behaviour is correct and respectable, so the word works as a synonym for polite.

clue.text: Mistreated hair tends to get discoloured

indicators.note: mistreated suggests handled badly, so the letters of hair tends are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Hair that has been badly treated tends to lose its colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Metal that is dulled or stained by exposure has lost its colour, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Tintin's dance

parts.note: a tin is a can
a second tin, another can

explanation.walkthrough: Tintin the boy reporter is a red herring: read his name as 'tin tin', two cans.
explanation.definitionFit: The high-kicking Parisian music-hall routine is a famous example of a dance.

clue.text: Sick of being out in the rain?

definitions.meaning: literally beneath whatever the skies are throwing down

explanation.surface: Someone feeling ill because they got caught in a downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for feeling slightly ill also reads literally as standing beneath the rain and clouds.

clue.text: Little bear in Surinam trained to get gold

indicators.note: trained suggests the letters of Surinam are put through a new routine and rearranged

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A bear cub in the South American country is trained to win a gold medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little bear' looks like a cub; it is the Latin name of the constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: The northern constellation's Latin name translates as the lesser bear, containing the Pole Star.

clue.text: Stove popular once more?

parts.note: an Aga is a brand of heavy cast-iron range cooker popular in British country kitchens
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Is the stove back in fashion once more?
explanation.walkthrough: AGA is a British range-cooker brand.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something once more is doing it a second time, a plain synonym.

clue.text: US estate agent finds central Surrey accommodation for English singer

indicators.note: giving accommodation means housing, so the middle pair houses the next pieces
the central letters of the word Surrey, its middle pair, are taken

parts.note: an alto is a singer in the lower female or high male range

explanation.surface: An American property dealer finds a house in Surrey for an English singer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodation for' puts E plus ALTO between the two Rs at the heart of Surrey.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans call a person who sells houses and land for clients by this term, the British estate agent.

clue.text: Greek deity suffering in style

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild and shepherds
an ache is pain or suffering

explanation.surface: A Greek god endures his pain with great style.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamboyant confidence and flair is a kind of style, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Endless lament about part of crossword

indicators.note: about signals turning the trimmed word round
endless means the final letter of the synonym is lost

parts.note: a dirge is a mournful song, a lament

explanation.surface: A setter grumbles endlessly about one part of the crossword.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' cuts DIRGE to DIRG; 'about' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The pattern of black and white squares is the framework of any crossword puzzle.

clue.text: Very holy carcass not damaged

indicators.note: damaged suggests broken up, so the letters of carcass not are scrambled

explanation.surface: A relic's body has been kept intact because it is so sacred.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sacred and inviolable, beyond criticism or interference, is regarded as very holy.

clue.text: Emulsion thrown over top of informer's car

indicators.note: over suggests the shuffled paint is draped over the next letter, enclosing it
thrown like pottery on a wheel, the letters of emulsion are reshaped
the top of a down entry word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Paint is flung over the grass's luxury car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown' rearranges EMULSION; 'over' wraps it round I, the top of 'informer's'.
explanation.definitionFit: A large chauffeur-driven luxury vehicle is a type of car.

clue.text: Stop ignoring North American insect

indicators.note: ignoring signals that the following letters are dropped

parts.note: to terminate is to stop or end

explanation.surface: An instruction to stop disregarding a North American bug.
explanation.definitionFit: The wood-eating colony-building creature is an insect.

clue.text: Cover found in gamekeeper's heather

indicators.note: the letters wanted are found within the words gamekeeper's heather

explanation.surface: Cover for game birds is found in the gamekeeper's heather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cover' looks like a noun, the hiding place; it is the verb, to encase.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a blade into its case is to encase or cover it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Garment seen in cartoonist's penultimate strip

indicators.note: penultimate means next to last, the letter before the final one of the cartoonist

parts.note: to strip is to undress

explanation.surface: A garment appears in the cartoonist's second-to-last comic strip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strip' looks like a comic strip; it is the verb, to take clothes off.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, sleeveless summer frock is a garment.

clue.text: Island where secretive Chinese society adopts new identity

indicators.note: adopting takes something in, so the society takes the next letters inside

parts.note: a triad is a Chinese secret criminal society
ID is short for identity

explanation.surface: An island where a Chinese gang hides out by taking on new identities.
explanation.definitionFit: The larger of the two Caribbean islands forming a republic with Tobago.

clue.text: Menu is changed around since end of restaurant's bad luck

indicators.note: around tells us the shuffled letters go round the next pieces
changed indicates the letters of menu is are altered in order

parts.note: for can mean since or because

indicators.note: the end of the word restaurant is its final letter

explanation.surface: A restaurant changing its menu because of hard times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'since' can mean 'for', as in 'for it was late'; 'changed' and 'around' together shuffle MENU IS and wrap it round that and T.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill fortune, an unlucky event or state, is a synonym of bad luck.

clue.text: Small sailor turning up to get special footwear

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: in a down entry turning up reads the word to from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A short sailor arrives to collect some special shoes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' looks like arriving; it reverses TO into OT.
explanation.definitionFit: These carved wooden clogs, worn by French peasants, are a type of footwear.

clue.text: Leaders of tank regiment given acknowledgement of mistake by soldiers

indicators.note: the leading letters of the words tank and regiment are taken

parts.note: oops is what one says on making a blunder

explanation.surface: Tank regiment commanders admit to a blunder made by their men.
explanation.definitionFit: Armed forces personnel collectively, the rank and file, are soldiers.

clue.text: Tool box?

definitions.meaning: a rasp-like tool for smoothing metal or wood
a box for papers, a box ___ in an office

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the abrasive hand tool and a container for storing documents.

clue.text: Notice about You Tube?

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the synonym wraps round the next letter

parts.note: to spot is to notice
U sounds like you, the texting abbreviation

explanation.surface: Spotting something on the YouTube video site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'You Tube' poses as the website; split, 'You' is U and 'Tube' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The pipe through which a kettle or teapot pours is a short tube.

clue.text: Graduates tucking into tortilla with relish

indicators.note: tucking into puts the graduates inside the next piece

parts.note: a taco is a folded tortilla
BAs, Bachelors of Arts, are graduates

explanation.surface: Graduates tuck into a Mexican snack with gusto.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with relish' looks like with enthusiasm; 'relish' is the definition, a condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: The fiery pepper sauce is a condiment, which is what relish means here.

clue.text: Salesman forced Tina to put another coat on

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is a travelling salesman

indicators.note: forced implies pushed out of shape, so the letters of Tina are rearranged

explanation.surface: A salesman made Tina put on another coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coat' looks like clothing; it is a layer of paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Applying a fresh layer of paint means adding another coat.

clue.text: Tea cooked in space is consumed

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of tea are prepared into a new order

parts.note: an en is a printing space, half an em

explanation.surface: Tea made in space has been drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: EN is a printer's unit of space.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that has been eaten up has been consumed, a past participle synonym.

clue.text: Ask for job at university before lecturer gets put away

parts.note: a post is a job
to put away food is to eat it, so ate

explanation.surface: Someone applies for a university job before a lecturer gets locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put away' looks like imprisoned; it means ate, as in putting away a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To claim or demand as a basis for argument; the older sense is to request or demand.
